chapterInfo.content:
11
Ɔsetie ho kɔkɔbɔ
1Enti dɔ AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn, na hwɛ n’ahwɛdeɛ, n’ahyɛdeɛ ne n’atemmudeɛ ne ne mmara nsɛm nna nyinaa. 2Na monhunu nnɛ, (na ɛnyɛ mene mo mma a wɔnnim na wɔnhunuiɛ no) monhunu AWURADE mo Nyankopɔn ntea, ne kɛseyɛ, ne nsa a ɛyɛ den ne ne basa a watene mu 3ne ne nsɛnkyerɛnneɛ ne ne nneyɛeɛ a ɔyɛɛ no Misraim a ɔde yɛɛ Misraimhene Farao ne n’asase nyinaa, 4#Eks 14.25, 27 ne deɛ ɔyɛɛ Misraim dɔm ne n’apɔnkɔ ne ne nteaseɛnam a wɔde reti mo a ɔmaa Mmɛwa Po mu nsuo bu faa wɔn soɔ, na AWURADE sɛee wɔn, de abɛduru nnɛ da yi, 5ne deɛ ɔyɛɛ mo ɛserɛ so bɛsii sɛ moduruu ha yi, 6#Num 16.31-35 ne deɛ ɔyɛɛ Ruben ba Eliab mma Datan ne Abiram a asase buee n’anomu menee wɔn ne wɔn afie ne wɔn ntomadan ne wɔn a wɔdii wɔn akyire nyinaa firii Israel nyinaa mfimfini no; 7na mo ani ahunu AWURADE nneyɛeɛ akɛseɛ a ɔyɛeɛ no nyinaa.
8Enti monni mmara nsɛm a merehyɛ mo nnɛ yi nyinaa so, na mo ho ayɛ den, na moakɔ akɔfa asase a moretwam akɔ so akɔfa no, 9#Eks 3.17 na mo nna aware asase a AWURADE kaa mo nananom ntam sɛ ɔde bɛma wɔn ne wɔn asefoɔ no so, asase a ɛsene nufosuo ne ɛwoɔ no. 10Na asase a worekɔ akɔfa no nte sɛ Misraim asase a mofiri so baeɛ a woguu w’aba na wode wo nan guguu so nsuo sɛ ɛfan turo mu no; 11na asase a moretwam akɔ so akɔfa no yɛ mmepɔ ne mmonhwa asase a ɛnom ɔsoro nsuo, 12#Dwom 65.9-10 asase a AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn hwɛ so daa, a n’ani wɔ so firi afe mfitiaseɛ kɔsi afe awieeɛ.
13 # Lew 26.3-39 Na sɛ motie me mmara nsɛm a mede merema mo nnɛ yi, sɛ mode mo akoma nyinaa bɛdɔ AWURADE mo Nyankopɔn na moasom no a, 14ɛnneɛ mɛma mo asase so osuo atɔ ne berɛ mu, asusɔ ne bereamporɔ, na woaboaboa w’aburoo ne wo nsa ne wo ngo ano, 15na mɛma wo serɛ so aba wira ama w’afieboa, na woadidi amee. 16Monhwɛ mo ho yie na wɔannaadaa mo akoma, na moammane ankɔsom anyame foforɔ ansɔre wɔn, 17#Lew 26.19; Deut 28.23 na AWURADE abufuo annɛre antia mo, na wanto ɔsoro mu sɛ osuo nntɔ na asase mmma ne nnɔbaeɛ, na moansɛe ntɛm so amfiri asase pa a AWURADE de rema mo no so.
18 # Deut 6.6-9 Enti momfa me nsɛm yi nsie mo akoma ne mo kra mu, na fa yɛ nsɛnkyerɛnneɛ kyekyere wo nsa, na ɛnyɛ w’aniwa ntam nkaeɛ abotire; 19na momfa nkyerɛkyerɛ mo mma, na kasa ho w’afitena mu ne wo kwan so nanteɛ mu ne wo nna mu ne wo sɔreɛ mu; 20na twerɛ gu wo fie aponnwa ho ne w’aponkɛseɛ so; 21na wo nna ne wo mma nna adɔɔso asase a AWURADE kaa wo nananom ntam sɛ ɔde bɛma wɔn no so, sɛdeɛ ɔsoro a ɛkata asase soɔ yi nna teɛ. 22Na sɛ mobɛdi mmara nsɛm a merehyɛ mo yi so ayɛ, na moadɔ AWURADE mo Nyankopɔn anante n’akwan nyinaa so na moabata ne ho a, 23#Deut 7.1-2 ɛnneɛ AWURADE bɛtutu amanaman yi nyinaa afiri mo anim, na moafa amanaman akɛseɛ a wɔyɛ den sene mo. 24Baabiara a mo nan bɛtia no bɛyɛ mo deɛ, ɛfiri ɛserɛ so ne Lebanon, ɛfiri Asubɔntene Eufrate ho, kɔsi akyiri po no ano bɛyɛ mo asase. 25Obiara rentumi nnyina mo anim; AWURADE mo Nyankopɔn de mo ho hu ne mo ho suro bɛgu asase a mobɛfa soɔ nyinaa so, sɛdeɛ ɔka kyerɛɛ mo no.
Nhyira ne nnome
26 # Deut 30.1, 15 Hwɛ, mede nhyira ne nnome meregu mo anim nnɛ: 27#Deut 28.2, 15 Sɛ motie AWURADE mo Nyankopɔn mmara nsɛm a merehyɛ mo nnɛ yi a, mobɛnya nhyira, 28na sɛ moantie AWURADE mo Nyankopɔn mmara nsɛm na momane firi ɔkwan a merehyɛ mo nnɛ yi so kɔdi anyame foforɔ a monni wɔn akyiri a, mobɛnya nnome. 29#Deut 27.12-13; Yos 8.33-34 Na sɛ AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn de wo duru asase a worekɔ akɔfa no so a, ka nhyira no Gerisim bepɔ so ne nnome no nso Ebal bepɔ so. 30#Gye 12.6; Yos 9.6; 10.6 Ɛnni Yordan agya, owiatɔeɛ kwan no akyi, Kanaanfoɔ a wɔte Araba asase so, Gilgal ntentensoɔ, More pɔ ho? 31Na morebɛtwa Yordan akɔ akɔfa asase a AWURADE mo Nyankopɔn de rema mo no, na mobɛfa atena so. 32Enti monhwɛ yie na monyɛ ahyɛdeɛ ne atemmudeɛ a mede meresi mo anim nnɛ yi nyinaa.

pageProps.chapterText:
Enti dɔ AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn, na hwɛ n’ahwɛdeɛ, n’ahyɛdeɛ ne n’atemmudeɛ ne ne mmara nsɛm nna nyinaa. Na monhunu nnɛ, (na ɛnyɛ mene mo mma a wɔnnim na wɔnhunuiɛ no) monhunu AWURADE mo Nyankopɔn ntea, ne kɛseyɛ, ne nsa a ɛyɛ den ne ne basa a watene mu ne ne nsɛnkyerɛnneɛ ne ne nneyɛeɛ a ɔyɛɛ no Misraim a ɔde yɛɛ Misraimhene Farao ne n’asase nyinaa, ne deɛ ɔyɛɛ Misraim dɔm ne n’apɔnkɔ ne ne nteaseɛnam a wɔde reti mo a ɔmaa Mmɛwa Po mu nsuo bu faa wɔn soɔ, na AWURADE sɛee wɔn, de abɛduru nnɛ da yi, ne deɛ ɔyɛɛ mo ɛserɛ so bɛsii sɛ moduruu ha yi, ne deɛ ɔyɛɛ Ruben ba Eliab mma Datan ne Abiram a asase buee n’anomu menee wɔn ne wɔn afie ne wɔn ntomadan ne wɔn a wɔdii wɔn akyire nyinaa firii Israel nyinaa mfimfini no; na mo ani ahunu AWURADE nneyɛeɛ akɛseɛ a ɔyɛeɛ no nyinaa.
Enti monni mmara nsɛm a merehyɛ mo nnɛ yi nyinaa so, na mo ho ayɛ den, na moakɔ akɔfa asase a moretwam akɔ so akɔfa no, na mo nna aware asase a AWURADE kaa mo nananom ntam sɛ ɔde bɛma wɔn ne wɔn asefoɔ no so, asase a ɛsene nufosuo ne ɛwoɔ no. Na asase a worekɔ akɔfa no nte sɛ Misraim asase a mofiri so baeɛ a woguu w’aba na wode wo nan guguu so nsuo sɛ ɛfan turo mu no; na asase a moretwam akɔ so akɔfa no yɛ mmepɔ ne mmonhwa asase a ɛnom ɔsoro nsuo, asase a AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn hwɛ so daa, a n’ani wɔ so firi afe mfitiaseɛ kɔsi afe awieeɛ.
Na sɛ motie me mmara nsɛm a mede merema mo nnɛ yi, sɛ mode mo akoma nyinaa bɛdɔ AWURADE mo Nyankopɔn na moasom no a, ɛnneɛ mɛma mo asase so osuo atɔ ne berɛ mu, asusɔ ne bereamporɔ, na woaboaboa w’aburoo ne wo nsa ne wo ngo ano, na mɛma wo serɛ so aba wira ama w’afieboa, na woadidi amee. Monhwɛ mo ho yie na wɔannaadaa mo akoma, na moammane ankɔsom anyame foforɔ ansɔre wɔn, na AWURADE abufuo annɛre antia mo, na wanto ɔsoro mu sɛ osuo nntɔ na asase mmma ne nnɔbaeɛ, na moansɛe ntɛm so amfiri asase pa a AWURADE de rema mo no so.
Enti momfa me nsɛm yi nsie mo akoma ne mo kra mu, na fa yɛ nsɛnkyerɛnneɛ kyekyere wo nsa, na ɛnyɛ w’aniwa ntam nkaeɛ abotire; na momfa nkyerɛkyerɛ mo mma, na kasa ho w’afitena mu ne wo kwan so nanteɛ mu ne wo nna mu ne wo sɔreɛ mu; na twerɛ gu wo fie aponnwa ho ne w’aponkɛseɛ so; na wo nna ne wo mma nna adɔɔso asase a AWURADE kaa wo nananom ntam sɛ ɔde bɛma wɔn no so, sɛdeɛ ɔsoro a ɛkata asase soɔ yi nna teɛ. Na sɛ mobɛdi mmara nsɛm a merehyɛ mo yi so ayɛ, na moadɔ AWURADE mo Nyankopɔn anante n’akwan nyinaa so na moabata ne ho a, ɛnneɛ AWURADE bɛtutu amanaman yi nyinaa afiri mo anim, na moafa amanaman akɛseɛ a wɔyɛ den sene mo. Baabiara a mo nan bɛtia no bɛyɛ mo deɛ, ɛfiri ɛserɛ so ne Lebanon, ɛfiri Asubɔntene Eufrate ho, kɔsi akyiri po no ano bɛyɛ mo asase. Obiara rentumi nnyina mo anim; AWURADE mo Nyankopɔn de mo ho hu ne mo ho suro bɛgu asase a mobɛfa soɔ nyinaa so, sɛdeɛ ɔka kyerɛɛ mo no.

Hwɛ, mede nhyira ne nnome meregu mo anim nnɛ: Sɛ motie AWURADE mo Nyankopɔn mmara nsɛm a merehyɛ mo nnɛ yi a, mobɛnya nhyira, na sɛ moantie AWURADE mo Nyankopɔn mmara nsɛm na momane firi ɔkwan a merehyɛ mo nnɛ yi so kɔdi anyame foforɔ a monni wɔn akyiri a, mobɛnya nnome. Na sɛ AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn de wo duru asase a worekɔ akɔfa no so a, ka nhyira no Gerisim bepɔ so ne nnome no nso Ebal bepɔ so. Ɛnni Yordan agya, owiatɔeɛ kwan no akyi, Kanaanfoɔ a wɔte Araba asase so, Gilgal ntentensoɔ, More pɔ ho? Na morebɛtwa Yordan akɔ akɔfa asase a AWURADE mo Nyankopɔn de rema mo no, na mobɛfa atena so. Enti monhwɛ yie na monyɛ ahyɛdeɛ ne atemmudeɛ a mede meresi mo anim nnɛ yi nyinaa.

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
